findings.issue: The job fence is released by the raw-evidence commit at line 141. PDF retrieval can then wait while the lease expires and another worker claims the job. Add a deterministic two-session test that expires/reclaims the lease during PDF retrieval and verifies no stale PDF or Interpretation write survives. Rerun affected and final gates and freeze a new manifest for fresh independent review.
